title: Claude Agent SDK
motto: The Claude Agent SDK is the library form of the Claude Code harness. Built-in tools, subagents for context isolation, hooks, W3C trace propagation, session store parity. Claude Managed Agents is the hosted alternative for long-running async work.

steps.title: Core idea
steps.body: The Claude Agent SDK is the library form of the Claude Code harness. Built-in tools, subagents for context isolation, hooks, W3C trace propagation, session store parity. Claude Managed Agents is the hosted alternative for long-running async work.

steps.title: Why this matters
cards: A raw LLM API gets you one round-trip. A production agent needs tool execution, MCP servers, lifecycle hooks, subagent spawning, session persistence, trace propagation. Claude Agent SDK ships this shape as a library — the same harness Claude Code uses, exposed for custom agents.

steps.title: The concept
steps.body: Computer use, bash, and structured tool loops for Claude agents.
